Bug_Title: Virtual threads should not run tasks that include synchronized code
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the `showBug` method, which starts a virtual thread that executes a synchronized block. This will cause the virtual thread to stay pinned to the underlying OS thread during its execution, which can impact the scalability of the application.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when a virtual thread executes a synchronized block, causing the virtual thread to stay pinned to the underlying OS thread during its execution.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results show that the test 'testShowBug' has passed without any failure. The absence of a test failure indicates that the bug, which is triggered when a virtual thread executes a synchronized block, was not triggered during the execution of the test.
